facts.fact: 取水：Edwin 以 water compass 寻 drakusel 象树——Fin 接手、土魔法剖树取水、对树低声「Sorry」——「Warmth flowered in his chest」。

Fin 的清算一：「you were guarded...your uncertainty, your sadness, your hope」「I saw your guilt. I see it still. It’s never gone away.」「you've always been brave, Nik, no matter how much you want to deny it.」
facts.anchor: I see it still. It’s never gone away.

facts.fact: Fin 的清算二：「Noctus was… a horror. But it's not enough to survive, is it?」「What will capturing Taesia actually accomplish, other than fulfilling your idea of revenge?」「You’re obsessed with the people who've hurt you...Why do you keep refusing to use the prosthetic? Why can't you look at me?」
facts.anchor: Why can’t you look at me?

facts.fact: 王位自疑与跪拜戏：「Am I really fit for the throne of Vaega? Do I even know how to lead?」「Is this what it would have been like, if we’d fulfilled the roles assigned to us at birth? Would you have been presented to me as a gift, or a promise?」——「Get on your knees.」——velvet runner 与王座的想象。
摘罩：Look at me 两令——指尖抬 chin——摘下眼罩（拇指轻描空窝下睑）——「There you are, Sunshine.」「I’ve got you.」——「There was no pity there, no revulsion.」
喜剧解压：Edwin 开树喷水自湿——「An injustice...depict this scene as farcically as possible.」「Fartily?」——Nikolas 笑出声（weeks/months 来第一次）——「lighter than he had in days—weeks—maybe even months」。
Edwin 的疤：左臂白疤成行成弧「purposefully etched」——「Only a bit of nonsensical decoration」遮掩换衣束腰带。
facts.anchor: a series of lines and arcs that had been purposefully etched there.

facts.fact: 章末双线：Julian 面容紧绷（听见别人听不见的）；Nikolas 空窝刺痛（谎称 headache）——「Like tomorrow, when he would finally face Taesia and decide if he wanted her apologies or her life.」——几英里外黑墙前发现遗体。
facts.anchor: Like tomorrow, when he would finally face Taesia
